title: Payment Standing Share of the Early-Payment Discount — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet invoice, the discount standing share follows the account's payment record:

| Account's record in the last twelve whole months | The discount is multiplied by |
|---|---|
| A late fee was assessed on the account and no payment was returned in that time | 0.5 |
| A payment was returned on the account (whether or not a late fee was assessed) | 0.25 |
| Neither | not reduced |

**Window.** A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the day the discount is worked out, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on that day count.

**Hypothetical.** A discount figured at 42.80 on an account assessed a late fee four months ago and with no returned payment becomes 21.40; with a check returned two months ago it becomes 10.70.
